Bay Adventures

Adventure awaits. Bay Adventures are free activities that take place at our reserves using trails, rivers, and beaches across the watershed and include a variety of hands-on, outdoor activities such as hiking, biking, kayaking, fishing, and more.

Itty-Bitty Bay Adventure at Horseshoe Mill

Time: 10 am | Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

We'll meet at the trailhead for a brief introduction before setting off on a 1/2-mile nature walk. Along the way, we'll explore the outdoors, make discoveries, and enjoy a fun activity designed to help little ones connect with nature. Afterward, each family will receive a special book to take home and enjoy together.

Sunset Dog Walk at Horseneck Beach

Time: 2:30 pm | 2 hours

In partnership with OutHounds, We'll enjoy the beautiful shoreline, follow the paved pathway toward Gooseberry Island, cross the causeway, and stop at the historic World War II watchtowers for a short break. Then we'll head back to Horseneck Beach, enjoying the scenic coastline as we make our way back in time for sunset.

Itty-Bitty Bay Adventure at The Sawmill

Time: 10 am | Duration: 1 hour

Check-in at the learning center, where we'll start with a seasonal storytime. Then, we'll head on over to the trailhead to handout gear. Kids will navigate the trails, explore the ecosystems, and discover plants, animals, and mushrooms along the way. Restrooms and a water bottle refill station will be available inside the learning center. Feel free to pack a lunch and enjoy a picnic in our outdoor amphitheater after the program.

Baysgiving Shellfishing and Quahog Boil

Time: 3 pm | Duration 3 hours 30 minutes

Take a boat ride over to Burgess Point, step into some waders, and learn how to shellfish for quahogs! After the harvest, head back to Onset Bay Center to learn how to prepare the quahogs, with help from a local chef, and, of course, feast on what we've made!

Intro to Shellfishing at North Cove

Time: 2:30 pm | Duration: 1 hour

Curious about local shellfishing? Join us at the shoreline to learn the basics! After check-in, we’ll suit up and start with an on-land demonstration before heading out at low tide to harvest local shellfish together. We provide all the gear you need, including waders, rakes, measuring gauges, and harvest baskets. No license needed!

Adventure Ready at the Sawmill

Time: 10 am | Duration: 1 hour

Join the Buzzards Bay Coalition and our partners from the American Red Cross for Adventure Ready — an empowering crash course in first aid and CPR compression basics. Perfect for hikers, outdoor enthusiasts, and families who want to be more prepared on the trail. This is an introductory session only — it will not provide certification. If you're inspired to take the next step, the American Red Cross offers full certification courses to continue your training.

Compass Kids at Four Ponds

Time: 10 am | Duration: 1 hour

Turn your family trail walk into an outdoor navigation quest with Compass Kids! Learn the basics of compass navigation as we follow directional bearings along the trail to find eight hidden checkpoints. At each checkpoint, kids will punch their control cards and use a new compass bearing to find their way to the next post. Follow all eight bearings to reach the final treasure box, where each child can claim a prize!

Migratory Bird Walk at Gooseberry Island

Time: 1 pm | Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes

Join us for a Migratory Bird Walk at Gooseberry Island, a beautiful coastal stop along the Atlantic Flyway! Explore the shoreline and trails in search of loons, mergansers, ducks, and other migratory birds. Keep an eye out—you never know what you might spot, including a snowy owl!
